verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents an explicit expiration_date feature that stops a memory from surfacing in search once the date passes, working on both Platform and Open Source, and clarifies it's a soft-delete (nothing is deleted). This directly covers TTL/expiration-based decay, but there is no documented recency-weighting or automatic decay scoring in ranking, and no independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs. Missing for 10: recency-weighted scoring/automatic decay without manual expiration_date, independent verification of the expiration behavior working as claimed.
